xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfNonComplianceOfBoardC: During the March 2025 quarter, Mr. Laxman S. Uppar, Independent Director completed his tenure and hence the vacancy arose in his position. This resulted in falling of percentage of Independent Directors below the level as prescribed by the SEBI. With regard to the vacant positions of the Independent Directors, the Government of India has not made any appointments. Since, these vacant positions are beyond the authorities of the Board of the Bank, the Bank currently could not ensure 100% compliance as on March 31, 2025.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfNonComplianceOfCompos: The composition of ACB is governed by the guidelines issued by the Govt. of India and RBI. ACB of the Bank complies with all the requirements of composition in terms of SEBI Listing Regulations except requirement of 2/3 of Independent Members as of now due to vacancies on the Board. We note to comply in due course.

Due to cessation of Shri Laxman S Uppar, Independent Director on March 20, 2025, the number of members of the NRC fell below three as on March 31, 2025. However, we wish to inform that the Board on April 1, 2025 reconstituted the NRC and nominated Mr. Prakash Chandra Kandpal, Independent Director on the NRC. Thus, as of now, the number of Directors on NRC is in compliance with SEBI requirement.
